entry.title: Make restore idempotent, cap spend per invocation, bound the batch wa…
entry.content:
Make restore idempotent, cap spend per invocation, bound the batch wait, report git failures

Final-review fixes on the day's three plans. `restore` targets the last
`pre <command>` commit and skips its own `pre restore` commits, so a second
restore lands where the first did. `run --spend-cap` measures the judge and
tts cost this invocation spent, not the record's lifetime total, and prints
both numbers when it trips; `--max-wait-seconds` (default 43200) bounds the
wait on one batch. A HistoryError or OSError from the deck-safety guard is
reported as `deck safety unavailable:` with exit 1 instead of a traceback.
Tests added for the assess-first-then-source fall-through over one
candidate set and for a listed productive Target below the cutoff
surviving derivation. TODO records the legacy thai_deck_gen TTS key leak.
